# m2ir

> Evidence-backed YAML reference for MikroTik RouterOS binary protocols and data formats. Schema content is CC0-1.0. This file is a reading map; AGENTS.md governs repository contributions.

Read canonical YAML before implementing behavior. Follow each entry's
confidence, evidence, version scope, and revision history. Research notes
can contain earlier beliefs that the schema has since corrected. A finding
on RouterOS 6.49.23 or 7.25 is not a guarantee for other versions or devices.

## Orientation

- [README.md](README.md): Mission, coverage, WinBox compatibility context, and current research.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Contributor instructions and pointers to path-scoped rules.
- [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md): Canonical YAML, physical/profile/concept layers, and confidence vocabulary.
- [BOOTSTRAP.md](BOOTSTRAP.md): Bun setup, checks, and repository tooling.

## WinBox transport and messages

Read these in order when implementing the wire conversation:

- [Profile](profiles/winbox-ipc/profile.yaml): Context, namespaces, and schema references.
- [Wire grammar](physical/nv-message.yaml): M2 types, lengths, compact encodings, and nesting.
- [Transport](profiles/winbox-ipc/transport.yaml): TCP chunk framing.
- [Handshake](profiles/winbox-ipc/ec-srp5-handshake.yaml): EC-SRP5 authentication and evidence-backed encoding details.
- [Session crypto](profiles/winbox-ipc/session-crypto.yaml): Key derivation, encrypted envelopes, and message authentication.

## Native retrieval, handlers, and attributes

For work such as centrs retrieve, continue here. Terminal execution does
not establish native retrieval or notification behavior.

- [GUI handlers](profiles/winbox-ipc/gui-handlers.yaml): Selected handler routes, request/reply shapes, field mappings, and gaps.
- [System keys](profiles/winbox-ipc/sys-keys.yaml): Routing, request correlation, and message envelope attributes.
- [Standard keys](profiles/winbox-ipc/std-keys.yaml): Session/standard attributes and object-list metadata.
- [Standard commands](profiles/winbox-ipc/std-commands.yaml): Command identities, including retrieval and notification operations.
- [Standard errors](profiles/winbox-ipc/std-errors.yaml): Error identities and evidence.
- [Processes](profiles/winbox-ipc/processes.yaml): Process identities, version differences, and unresolved conflicts.
- [Private and legacy commands](profiles/winbox-ipc/commands.yaml): Handler-specific commands, including terminal-related evidence.
- [WinBox profile guide](profiles/winbox-ipc/README.md): Full file index, including mproxy and undo.

## Active research and compatibility

These are investigation trails and experimental tooling, not a replacement
for the canonical schema. Consult them for reproductions and unresolved
questions. RouterOS 7.25 lab queries do not prove full WinBox 3 compatibility;
forum theories about future protocol changes are not established behavior.

- [Client analysis](work/2026-10-winbox-client-re/README.md): WinBox 3.43 analysis using REA/Ghidra.
- [CHR analysis](work/2026-10-chr-extraction/README.md): RouterOS extraction, binary analysis, quickchr probes, and promotion status.
- [Live probe findings](work/2026-10-chr-extraction/ws3c-prober-findings.md): Version-scoped observations, transcript references, corrections, and open questions.

## Other formats and sources

- [The Dude profile](profiles/dude-on-disk/profile.yaml): On-disk object classification and field-table references; do not transfer WinBox naming assumptions unchanged.
- [Profile index](profiles/README.md): Other usage contexts, including placeholder CDB and MNDP profiles.
- [Credits](CREDITS.md): Major upstream sources; detailed citations live in the YAML.
- [Source inventory](work/2026-05-winbox-nova-sources/winbox-nova-source-inventory.md): Additional public leads and prior scouting.
